summary: Frontend-only test of /contact (hero, contact cards, lead form Step 1 + Step 2 placeholder). All requested checks passed: hero eyebrow 'Contact', H1 'Let's talk cars' with 'cars' highlighted, intro; 3 cards (tel href=site.phoneHref, 6 socials target=_blank rel='noopener noreferrer', prequal-button-primary to CBC URL target=_blank + prequalNote). Empty Next -> banner 'Please fix the highlighted fields.' + 8 errors (firstName,lastName,email,phone,city,state,contactPreference,consent), aria-invalid=true + destructive border on inputs/selects, contact pref hint hidden while error; typing clears only that field's error. Email invalid -> 'Enter a valid email address.'. US phone 5551234567 -> (555) 123-4567; 9 digits invalid, 10 valid. UK: prefix +44, placeholder '123 456 789', digits unformatted, 5 invalid / 6 valid, capped at 14 digits; Canada keeps +1 NANP formatting. Country order US, Canada, disabled divider, then localeCompare alphabetical (200 options). State: 'Select a state' + 50 states + DC + 'Outside the United States' last (53). Toggles aria-pressed multi-select/untoggle. Valid Step 1 -> Step 2 'Coming next', 'Step 2 of 2', progress aria-valuenow=100, scrolled to form top below sticky header; Back restores all values (text, select, toggles, checkboxes). No /api/lead requests (only Cloudflare RUM POSTs). ?quotedPayment=2573 -> '$2,573/mo' note; none without param. /contact#get-started and header 'Get Your Dream Car' from /process land with section top 120px below header (105px). No SSN/DOB/income/employer/address fields, no closing-cta. Mobile 390: scrollWidth 390 before/after errors. 0 console errors.

issues: Native <select> (Country, State) renders ~2-3px shorter than adjacent text inputs (Phone, City) on desktop - slight bottom misalignment in the 2-col rows; consider explicit h-[same] or appearance-none with matching padding
Progress bar track (bg-muted on bg-surface) is nearly invisible, so 50% state reads as a short green line rather than half of a bar - consider a darker track

action_items: Before launch: replace placeholder site.phoneHref '[TEL LINK]', social hrefs '#', and Privacy Policy/Disclosures '#' links in consent copy
critical_code_review_comments: Code is clean and modular (all files <110 lines). Validation and state isolated in leadForm.js.
CountryPhoneFields.changeCountry calls setField 3 times with closure values.phone - works since phone value is read from current render, fine.
Social links are '#' placeholders with target=_blank - clicking opens a new tab of the same page; expected for placeholders but should be replaced.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iterations 1-8 passed. Contact testids listed in review request all present and working. Use REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL (build-foundation-28) for testing. Step 2 is a placeholder; next iteration likely implements Step 2 fields + /api/lead submission.
